unavailable.title: Database unavailable
unavailable.description: Nexploy cannot reach its PostgreSQL database right now. Your data is not lost — it is still on the server, and everything comes back as soon as the connection is restored.
unavailable.hint: The usual cause is a full disk on the server or a stopped Postgres container. Check the free disk space on the server and make sure the nexploy_postgres container is running.
